scope: No code modified. Reports under /audit-reports. Scores are expert estimates, not measured Lighthouse runs.

findings.title: Session token in localStorage + non-HttpOnly cookie
findings.impact: XSS or log/history leak yields full 30-day account takeover.
findings.recommendation: Issue session as HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite cookie set by backend; never expose token to JS.

findings.title: OAuth token passed in URL query
findings.impact: Token lands in history, server logs, Referer.
findings.recommendation: Backend sets HttpOnly cookie on redirect instead of ?token=.

findings.title: Products/Services write endpoints have no authorization
findings.impact: Any authenticated user can edit/delete the entire global catalog.
findings.recommendation: Gate behind admin role middleware, or add per-user ownership scoping.

findings.title: No HTTP rate limiting on any route
findings.recommendation: throttle:5,1 on auth endpoints; throttle:60,1 on public reads.

findings.title: Change Password is mocked (no API call)
findings.impact: Users believe their password changed when it did not.
findings.recommendation: Wire to a real backend endpoint or remove the form.

findings.title: GST verification returns fabricated data
findings.impact: Invents legal/trade name from PAN, always Active; autofilled onto card.
findings.recommendation: Integrate a real GSTIN API or clearly label/disable as mock.

findings.title: Checkout trusts client-supplied prices
findings.impact: Customer can order at arbitrary prices.
findings.recommendation: Resolve item prices server-side; validate card_slug with exists.

findings.title: Public card page has no SEO metadata
findings.impact: Most-shared page has no title/description/OG; blank link previews, generic indexing.
findings.recommendation: Add generateMetadata with title/description/canonical/openGraph.images from card data.

findings.title: Public card shows the global catalog (cross-tenant)
findings.impact: Every card displays the same unscoped products/services.
findings.recommendation: Scope products/services to the card owner server-side.

findings.title: Full WebGL hero statically imported & SSR'd on public card
findings.impact: ~600KB Three.js parsed before paint on mobile-first route; dual WebGL contexts.
findings.recommendation: dynamic(..., { ssr:false }) with MeshGradient fallback; gate on device.

findings.title: No mobile navigation menu
findings.impact: Primary nav vanishes on phones; no hamburger fallback.
findings.recommendation: Add a hamburger/drawer nav for < md.

findings.title: Dashboard sidebar uses <a href> not <Link>
findings.impact: Full page reload on every dashboard navigation.

findings.title: tsconfig target es5
findings.impact: Legacy transforms/polyfills bloat a React 19 app.

findings.title: Raw used app-wide instead of next/image
Client-only auth gating (no middleware.ts)
findings.impact: Protected UI flashes; auth re-runs each navigation.

findings.title: No reduced-motion handling (infinite 3D spins)
findings.impact: Vestibular trigger risk; ignores OS setting.

findings.title: 3D runs full-power on mobile; HDR env fetched
findings.recommendation: Gate 3D on capability; drop Environment preset on mobile.

findings.title: Register GitHub button defaults to type=submit
Services price sort yields NaN on null price
File uploads have no progress/error UI
findings.impact: Failures only console.error; user sees nothing.

findings.title: No rate limit + OTP brute-forceable
findings.impact: 6-digit code, no attempt cap, non-constant-time compare, bypasses verified-email.
findings.recommendation: Cap attempts, invalidate after N, hash_equals, require verified.

findings.title: CORS misconfigured
findings.impact: Trailing-slash/path origins never match; localhost may stay allowed in prod with credentials.
findings.recommendation: Exact scheme://host origins; remove localhost in prod.

findings.title: Missing composite index on appointments
findings.impact: Queried on every public card view.

findings.title: Public card light/dark hydration flash
findings.recommendation: Use cookie or CSS prefers-color-scheme before render.

findings.title: Native alert()/confirm() vs custom modals
findings.recommendation: Use the existing custom modal pattern.

findings.title: Service price serialized as 0 when null
Media upload lacks MIME/extension validation
findings.impact: Stored XSS via SVG/HTML; client-controlled extension.
findings.recommendation: mimes rule; derive extension server-side; non-executable path.

findings.title: Pincode proxy disables TLS verification
findings.recommendation: Use Http:: with TLS on; drop follow-redirects.

findings.title: Public lead/order endpoints unthrottled + send mail
Reflected error text from URL on login
findings.recommendation: Whitelist error codes to fixed strings.

findings.title: Dead buttons presented as functional
findings.impact: Delete Account / View All / row menu do nothing.

findings.title: Hardcoded fake +12% stat trend
findings.recommendation: Wire to real deltas or remove.

findings.title: No security headers / image config in next.config
findings.impact: No CSP/HSTS/etc; next/image unusable for remote images.

findings.title: Form labels lack htmlFor association
findings.impact: Label click doesn't focus; weak SR association.

findings.title: Mobile drawer lacks focus trap / Escape / role
Low contrast body text (zinc-500/600 on black)
Public card content uses non-semantic divs
No soft deletes (cascade wipes history)
findings.impact: Deleting a card permanently destroys leads/orders.

findings.title: AudioContext created per sound, never closed
findings.recommendation: Single shared lazy context; opt-in toggle.

findings.title: Profile update doesn't refresh AuthContext
findings.impact: Stale name in header/sidebar until reload.

findings.title: Inconsistent caching on public card (no-store vs revalidate)
findings.recommendation: Use ISR revalidate for card data.

findings.title: Proprietor image upload mutates state in place
No web font optimization
findings.recommendation: Adopt next/font or confirm system stack.

findings.title: Duplicated inline style blocks across auth pages
Tilt3D/FlipCard3D ignore reduced motion
findings.impact: Desktop reduced-motion users still get tilt.

findings.title: Client-side checkout pincode calls 3rd-party w/o abort
findings.impact: Race on rapid typing; external dependency.

findings.title: isAdmin hardcoded true on products page
findings.recommendation: Derive from user; rely on server checks.

findings.title: env() used outside config in controllers
Product/Service slug has no collision retry
scroll-behavior: smooth global, no reduced-motion guard

doneWell: apiFetch has 10s timeout/abort and normalized ApiError
Forgot-password avoids user enumeration; email verify uses hash_equals
Backend eager-loads relations; homepage stats cached 1h
Optimistic updates with revert (product toggle); Promise.all parallel fetches
aria-labels and rel=noreferrer on public card external links
